_doc: Machine-readable per-frame inventory (read by tools/dev/lint_per_frame.py; human view: tools/dev/PER_FRAME_INVENTORY.md). per_frame: code this fork added that runs every frame / tick, with its process, rate and collector state. not_per_frame: modules imported by a per-frame module or entry point that are upstream, start-up only or offline tools, with the reason. A ti_*.py or selfdrive/controls/lib/*.py imported by a per-frame entry point must be in one of the two lists.

frogpilot_process.where: frogpilot/frogpilot_process.py:57 config_realtime_process -> common/realtime.py:41 gc.disable(); Ratekeeper(1 / DT_MDL) at :55; on-road branch :112-116 (every modelV2 while started, engaged or not)

entry_points.call: CarController.update (tests, plan, ident, dither, stuck guard, lag guard, stats, flag / clear taps)
main loop tick: can_reads, car_side, map_input/map_profile, fresh_model, fresh_limit, Planner.step, plan_json, log_payload, tick_log
FrogPilotEvents.update (via FrogPilotPlanner.update): LaneDriftGate.update / lane_change_active, TI dropout, running wide, latch
FrogPilotPlanner.update TI block: steer_authority.predicted_drift_m / AdvisoryTrigger.update, ti_curve.curve_alert_mph / read_curve_code, latch count
LatControlNNFF.update (only with the NNFF toggle on; this fork changed it)
